name: Hammertoss Redux

authors.name: Operation Coinnectar Crew (HaxNation x FOSS Mumbai 2026)

description:
The Coinnectar implant never hardcodes its live C2. Like APT29's HAMMERTOSS, it resolves the current controller at runtime by walking a chain of innocent-looking resources on trusted hosts, each quietly pointing to the next. Defenders see traffic to reputable domains and move on.

You've recovered the seed the implant starts from. Walk the chain and recover the final C2 string — that string is the flag. Use the in-page resolver, or do it the implant's way with curl.
hints: Nothing here is hardcoded: each innocent resource points at the next. Read what the files contain, not just what they render.
The last hop is locked. Something you picked up on the way is the key.
